scope: Local historical-view archival and offline recovery verification; no production recovery or cross-region deployment

fixed_defect.description: On Linux, os.Rename replaced an existing final archive instead of reaching the checksum-validation fallback.
fixed_defect.before: Both new installation regressions failed: different contents were overwritten, and matching contents replaced the existing inode.
fixed_defect.after: Same-directory os.Link installs without replacement; existing regular files must match SHA-256 before reuse. Successful reuse removes the partial file and retains the original inode.
fixed_defect.filesystem_requirement: The archive filesystem must support same-directory hard links. Installation fails closed rather than falling back to replacement.

offline_tool.reads: One explicitly exported trusted manifest and its archive file; no database connection
validation: Single complete gzip member without trailing compressed data
Bounded JSONL decoding with known fields and supported content types
Record count and unique positive history IDs
Exact user UUID scope and viewed-time range
Canonical relative path inside selected directory; nested symlinks rejected

validation.worker_full_default_test_suite: passed; other opt-in database contracts were not re-enabled in that invocation

database_guards: Explicit confirmation required; omitted environments skip, incomplete configurations fail.
Both URLs must target the same explicit 127.0.0.1 port and exact disposable database name; host-override parameters rejected.
Worker login is non-superuser, cannot bypass RLS, belongs to platform_worker and cannot read platform.users, delete history or update manifests.
Schema v21 and empty user/work/history/media/outbox tables required before fixtures.
Shared advisory guard requires serial execution with other Worker contracts.

recovery_proof.flow: Synthetic PostgreSQL rows -> SQL soft deletion -> real Worker archive -> trusted manifest verification -> isolated transaction-local TEMP recovery -> exact comparison to retained originals
failure_injection: Non-directory archive destination: no manifest or archived_at committed.
Actual deferred SQL constraint failure at COMMIT: manifest and archived_at roll back; installed orphan remains and retry reuses the same inode.
Leaf-directory and base-parent-directory fsync failures: no manifest or archived_at committed; retry reuses the installed inode and synchronizes the full directory chain.

cleanup.temporary_archive_files_and_recovery_tab: Automatically removed by Go test cleanup and transaction-local TEMP-table lifecycle
cleanup.note: The count includes repeated contract executions. These synthetic append-only manifests are deliberately not mutated; the parent task disposes of the dedicated database.

boundaries: The manifest must come from a trusted source; a checksum is not a signature.
Run the verifier on an offline copy without an untrusted concurrent directory writer.
The contract applies synthetic SQL soft deletion; it does not exercise an authenticated history-clearing browser/API request.
TEMP-table recovery proves byte/field preservation without inserting into official history tables or making deleted history visible.
No real user data, physical retention purge, live cross-region copy, production restore or external provider request was performed.

durability_hardening.problem: Syncing only the temporary file left directory entries from MkdirAll and Link/Remove unflushed before the database commit.
before_database_manifest_insert: fsync the complete temporary gzip file
Install without replacement; fsync the actual existing inode when reusing matching content
fsync the installed archive directory and each finite ancestor, leaf to filesystem root
durability_hardening.retry_policy: Repeat directory synchronization even when paths already exist; a failed previous attempt may have created unsynced directories.
durability_hardening.failure_policy: Any file or directory synchronization failure returns before manifest INSERT and archived_at UPDATE; the database transaction rolls back.
durability_hardening.proof: Unit checks observe final installation before synchronization and exact leaf-to-root order on both first install and retry. Real PostgreSQL tests inject failures at the leaf and base-parent directory and verify unchanged rows/manifests plus same-inode successful retry.
durability_hardening.boundary: These are filesystem sync calls and injected failure contracts, not a hardware power-loss experiment.
